blocks.text: Biostatistics ke bunyadi hisse (components) kai ahem kaamon ko gher lete hain; yeh sab mil kar biology ya sehat ke data ko theek tarah jama karne, us ka analysis karne, matlab nikalne (interpretation) aur use istemal karne dete hain. Yeh hisse yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Chhe dabbe oopar se neeche teer ke saath: 1 Study Design and Experimental Planning, 2 Data Collection, 3 Data Management and Processing, 4 Data Analysis, 5 Interpretation of Results, 6 Presentation and Communication; har dabbe mein aik chhoti line (maslan primary or secondary data).
blocks.caption: Biostatistics ke chhe hisse, kitab ki tarteeb mein (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).

blocks.text: 1- Study design aur experiment ki planning

Is mein research ka sawal banana, maqsad (objectives) tay karna, aur hypothesis (andaze wala jawab) test karne ke liye experiments ya observational studies (mushahide wali studies) ki tarteeb banana shamil hai. Is mein population chunna, variables tay karna, randomization (qura andazi se baantna), confounding factors (beech mein aa kar nateeja bigaarne wali cheezen) ko control karna aur munasib sample size nikalna bhi aata hai. Achha study design durust (valid), bharosemand (reliable) aur ghair janibdar (unbiased) nataij deta hai.
Sahih aur kaam ka data jama karna bunyadi zaroorat hai. Yeh mukhtalif tareeqon se hota hai:

items: Primary data collection: seedha apna data, jo experiments, surveys, interviews, observations (mushahidaat) aur clinical trials se milta hai.
Secondary data collection: pehle se maujood data istemal karna, jaise chhapi hui research, hospital ke medical records, sarkari reports aur databases.

blocks.text: Jama kiye gaye data ko tarteeb se rakhna aur analysis se pehle us ki durusti check karna. Is mein data cleaning (ghalat ya adhoori entries theek karna), coding aur storage shamil hain, aur data ki raazdari (confidentiality) aur durusti (integrity) qaim rakhi jati hai.

Data ka khulasa karne, use bayan karne aur us se nateeja nikalne (inference) ke liye statistical techniques lagana. Descriptive statistics data ki khasiyatein batati hain (mean, median, mode, standard deviation waghera). Inferential statistics, jaise hypothesis testing, regression analysis aur modelling, sample data se poori population ke baare mein nataij nikalne deti hain.

Statistical nataij ko biology ya sehat ke kaam ke nataij mein badalna. Is mein analysis ka pas-e-manzar (context), us ki hudood (limitations) aur us ke andar mani hui baaton (assumptions) ko dhyan mein rakhna zaroori hai.
6- Pesh karna aur batana (presentation and communication)

Nataij ko charts aur graphs jaisi tasveeron aur saaf zabaan mein scientists, doctors aur aam logon tak pohanchana. Tareeqe aur nataij khul kar batana (transparency) zaroori hai, taa ke doosre kaam dobara kar sakein (reproducibility) aur nataij par bharosa ho.

blocks.prompt: Sarkari sehat report se liya gaya data primary hai ya secondary?
blocks.explanation: Secondary data, kyunke yeh pehle se maujood data hai jo kisi aur ne jama kiya tha. Primary data woh hai jo aap khud experiment, survey ya interview se jama karein.

items: Chhe hisse: study design, data collection, data management, data analysis, interpretation, presentation.
Primary data khud jama hota hai; secondary data pehle se maujood zariyon se liya jata hai.
Descriptive statistics data bayan karti hai; inferential statistics sample se population ka nateeja nikalti hai.
